new_rows.claim: The T412 "4×4 single-position leak" is a property of the replay engine's value-tie tie-break, not of the table and not of 4×4 Go. `src/t412_loop_onset.zig`'s `chooseWzo2` breaks ties among equal-pinned-value children by lowest cell index; inside the `L == H` region that can cycle forever in a position that is decisive and ≤ 10 plies from termination (all 45 visited `L == H` states carry finite DTT, range 1…10). On the identical 500-position bracketed fresh-start sample and the identical table `data/oracle-4x4-v2.wzo2`, changing only the tie-break to minimum-DTT takes capped games visiting `L == H` from **7 / 232 to 0 / 87** and `L == H` plies from **1,203 / 92,800 (1.30 %) to 0 / 34,800 (0.00 %)**; replicated on an independent sample (seed 997): **3 / 250 to 0 / 84**. A random-tie-break attribution control gives 0 / 89 (seed 42) and 1 / 86 (seed 997), so the effect is the degeneracy of a *fixed* tie-break rather than anything specific to the DTT column. Two corollaries: (i) the 4×4 cap rate itself is tie-break-dependent — 145 of the 232 capped games at seed 42 and 166 of 250 at seed 997 terminate once ties break by DTT, so T412's "capped 46.40 % at 4×4" measures the player as much as the table; (ii) under a DTT-aware optimal player 4×4 matches 3×3 — capped games are 100 % confined to `L < H`. **Scope:** 500-position samples of 1,962,142 bracketed fresh-start entries (0.025 %), two seeds; "0 capped games visiting `L == H`" means none detected in these two samples under this tie-break, not a proof over the table. T412's Q1 sibling test and Q1b DTT read are untouched — they contain no player.

notes: T571 (leaf, claude-opus-5, 2026-08-22), bundle untracked/T571-4x4-single-position-leak.md. Verdict: PASS-WITH-FINDINGS. The bundle offered two verdicts — (a) the leak is a writes-ON table artifact, (b) the leak is real — and both are refused for the same reason: "7 capped games touch L==H" is not a property of the 4×4 table. (1) REPRODUCED: re-running src/t412_loop_onset.zig --size 4 --sample 500 --seed 42 at HEAD gives every aggregate field and all 232 capped-game witnesses identical to docs/evidence/T412-LOOP-ONSET/loop-onset-4x4-opt.json, the 7 leaking games included; the 7 are pinned by (colex, side) in the analysis. (2) CONTRADICTION RESOLVED in favour of SOLUTION-TREE.md:153 (T380 F-8), against docs/research/loop-onset-2026-08-07.md:234-236: the run read only data/oracle-4x4-v2.wzo2; the `ko_ref >= d` guard exists only at src/oracle.zig:253 and src/retro.zig:593, and `grep -c 'ko_ref|memo_writes'` over src/exp6_solve.zig and src/oracle_v2_build.zig returns 0 and 0; the guard is not even expressible in a history-free Jacobi fixpoint (`d = hist.len - 1` needs a search path); and exp6_solve.zig touches disk only to write. The caveat was also aimed at the wrong half of the table — in WZO2 KO_SENSITIVE *is* L != H (src/artifact2.zig:489), so the leak's entries are all in the 95,677,624-entry clear column the foreclosure does not reach. The caveat was therefore never load-bearing. (3) CROSS-CHECK: the named writes-off files are disqualified on provenance (see 4x4.WRITESOFF-DUP), so the targeted re-derivation the bundle preferred is what stands — all 45 distinct L==H states satisfy their own one-step Bellman identity recomputed with exp6_solve.zig's independent successor generator: 0 violations / 45, N1 null control 0 / 5,000, S1 seeded-defect 45 / 45 with exact +1 shift. (4) VERDICT: tie-break artifact (see 4x4.LEAK-TIEBREAK). Doc updates applied: the loop-onset caveat, its synthesis bullet, its open-question bullet and its provenance sentence; SOLUTION-TREE.md §(b) item 7. SOLUTION-TREE.md was staged selectively (`git hash-object` + `git update-index --cacheinfo` on a HEAD-plus-my-hunk blob) because T573 holds an uncommitted edit to a different section of the same file — that edit is left in the working tree untouched and uncommitted. A defect found in this row's own control is recorded rather than quietly fixed: the first S1 build detected only 42/45 because the bias was not applied to double-pass terminal children, so states whose minimising optimum came from a terminal child were a blind spot; fixed before the reading was taken.
